newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan Aug rubber output for tyres up 2.6 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Japan Aug rubber output for tyres up 2.6 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Japanese rubber output for tyres in August totalled 75,787 tonnes, up 2.6 percent from the same period a last year but down 19.7 percent from July, the Japan Automobile Tyre Manufacturers' Association said on Wednesday.
The output decline from July was attributable to the summer holidays, the industry body said.
Domestic rubber shipments in August amounted to 48,389 tonnes, up 4.5 percent from the previous year but down 14.9 percent from July, the industry body said.
Japan's exports of rubber for tyres in August totalled 32,378 tonnes, up 1.1 percent from the same period a year earlier, but down 19.3 percent from July, it said.

"Export growth has shown signs of slowing down after robust growth earlier this year, but rubber output for new cars is expected to improve slightly later this year," an official of the industry body said.
